description: The file defines a final class 'CommandHandler' that manages MQTT command subscriptions, unsubscriptions, and PUBACK handling within an Eclipse Hono MQTT adapter context. It tracks active command subscriptions, manages acknowledgment timers, and provides mechanisms for adding/removing subscriptions and processing PUBACKs.

classes.name: CommandHandler
classes.description: Manages MQTT command subscriptions, acknowledgments, and PUBACK handling, tracking pending commands and their acknowledgment timers.

classes.name: CommandHandler.PendingCommandRequest
classes.description: Data class to hold information about a pending command, including timer ID, tenant object, subscription, and command context.

methods.name: CommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor initializing CommandHandler with Vertx instance and configuration.

methods.name: handlePubAck
methods.description: Processes PUBACK received for message ID, invoking optional callback and logging acknowledgment.

methods.name: addToWaitingForAcknowledgement
methods.description: Stores information about a published command awaiting acknowledgment, setting a timeout.

methods.name: removeFromWaitingForAcknowledgement
methods.description: Removes and returns the pending acknowledgment data for a given message ID.

methods.name: addSubscription
methods.description: Adds a command subscription with its message consumer.

methods.name: removeSubscription
methods.description: Removes a subscription for a specific topic and optionally invokes a consumer callback.

methods.name: removeAllSubscriptions
methods.description: Removes all current subscriptions, optionally invoking a callback for each.

methods.name: closeCommandConsumer
methods.description: Closes the command message consumer, logging success or failure.

methods.name: startTimer
methods.description: Initiates a timeout timer for awaiting acknowledgment, logging timeout events.

methods.name: cancelTimer
methods.description: Cancels a running acknowledgment timeout timer.
